title: Looking for a Poison Fog/Cloud A1 auto tile

posts.author: ericjustin81
posts.body:
Hey all,
Like the title says, if anyone can point me in the direction of a poison fog/cloud/mist A1 auto tile, I'd be most appreciative. Free for commercial is ideal, but I'll part with a few bucks if it isn't outrageous. The regular white world clouds aren't working well for me, because  want something that goes over small patches of about 8-9 tiles on top of an otherwise normal world (not over world) map.
Thanks!

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body: Hi there! Can you confirm what engine this is for and what engines you own so members can account for any licensing requirements?

posts.author: ericjustin81
posts.body: I'm so sorry, RPG Maker MZ is what I'm specifically using, but I do own MV also.

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body: Not a worry. Thanks! Much appreciated.
